pr_title: Extract actual Content-Type from the header
pr_body: This PR should fix #1866 by extracting the actual Content-Type from the header and ignoring everything that follows the first semicolon (`;`) which, most of the time, means ignoring the `charset=utf-8`. We use [the `mime_type` method](https://docs.rs/actix-web/3.3.2/actix_web/trait.HttpMessage.html#method.mime_type) to do so.

issue_context.title: Accept `charset` in `Content-Type` header
issue_context.body:
Replaces https://github.com/meilisearch/MeiliSearch/issues/1791

After discussion with the team, we want to permit `charset` in the `Content-Type` header for the routes requiring a body, so a `Content-Type` header.

### Reminder

The following routes should only accept `application/json` in this header and not `text/csv` or `application/x-ndjson`
- `POST indexes/`
- `PUT indexes/:uid`
- `POST indexes/:uid/documents/delete-batch`
- `POST indexes/:uid/search`
- `POST indexes/:uid/settings`
- all the sub-settings routes like `POST indexes/:uid/settings/XXX`

The following routes can accept `application/json`, `text/csv` or `application/x-ndjson`
- `PUT indexes/:uid/documents`
- `POST indexes/:uid/documents`
